column4: Josie M, Ryan H, Kelly H
column5: We taught a model to read knee MRIs for 12 different injuries with almost no ground truth — just 58 labeled studies out of 4,407 — by mining training labels from the multilingual radiology reports attached to the rest. The result scores 0.887 AUC on Kaggle's hidden test set, and we're wrapping it in an AI harness a clinician's assistant can call — a recipe for unlocking the millions of unlabeled scans hospitals already have.

Our flagship, Gauntlet Gamesmith, turns a simple prompt into a playable browser game through an automated build-and-critique loop.
Behind every result, it exposes the full trace: what changed, what it cost, and whether each iteration actually made the game better.

column4: Cristina G, Matt M, Kevin R
column5: You've hoarded a small fortune in points, and they lose value while you wonder if any redemption is actually worth taking. Wanderlink turns that research project into an answer on demand: every transfer mapped, every number backed by a source and a date, in our app or direct in your AI assistant.
There are many ways to communicate. Speaking, whispering and now for the first time silent articulation.
Research is broken. Let’s fix it.
